footnotes_as_printed: none printed (text states: values are averages of duplicate solutions except MgCl2 (single sample) and KCl at the three highest temperatures (single sample); dilute solutions corrected for a ~0.02 K temperature gradient by rotating the samples)
pressure_note: not stated; isopiestic equilibrium at the water vapour pressure of the solutions in a closed pressure vessel (saturation pressure)

reference.what: reference salt molality in the same isopiestic equilibrium

composition.other_species: each row is one isopiestic equilibrium: four solutions (NaCl reference, KCl, MgCl2, CaCl2) at equal water activity at the block temperature; reference NaCl molality is in column 1, test salts in columns 2-4

extra_unmapped: osmotic coefficients (calculated by authors, only plotted)
conversion_needs: osmotic coefficient of each test salt = (nu_NaCl m_NaCl / (nu m)) phi_NaCl, needs phi of the NaCl standard (Silvester and Pitzer equation cited by authors); not given in the table
